description: Move Salesforce Files (ContentVersion and ContentDocument) through REST API resources under /services/data/v{version} on the registered org. Operations: upload (POST /sobjects/ContentVersion; the file at an ABSOLUTE file_path under a saved location is sent base64-encoded as VersionData; body PathOnClient is required, Title, Description, ContentDocumentId (adds a new version to an existing file), FirstPublishLocationId (the record or library to share with), ReasonForChange and other ContentVersion fields pass through; the vendor limits this form to 37.5 MB of base64 data), download (reads the version's Id, ContentDocumentId, Title, PathOnClient, FileExtension, VersionNumber, ContentSize and Checksum, then GET /sobjects/ContentVersion/{content_version_id}/VersionData streams the bytes to an ABSOLUTE output_path under a saved location; the file is kept only when its size and MD5 match ContentSize and Checksum) and delete_document (DELETE /sobjects/ContentDocument/{content_document_id}; deletes the file and every version, to the recycle bin). Salesforce permissions alone decide each operation, including deletes. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Upload a local file into Salesforce Files, add a new version to an existing file, share it to a record, download a file version to a local path with its size and checksum verified, and delete a file with all its versions. Use for attachments, documents and file exchange with CRM records; org permissions decide.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), selected headers, body (upload: a SaveResult with the new ContentVersion id, success and errors; download: the version record with ContentDocumentId, Title, PathOnClient, FileExtension, VersionNumber, ContentSize and Checksum; delete_document: empty on 204), correlation_id, error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status, failures when the upload reports success false, and for a download output_path, bytes_written, md5, download_correlation_id and integrity_advisory when ContentSize or Checksum was unreadable so the bytes were kept unverified.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: An upload returns the ContentVersion id; read the ContentDocumentId with get_record when a follow-up needs the document. Relay a download's output_path and bytes_written; an integrity_advisory means the bytes are unverified. upload and delete_document change the org; delete_document removes every version of the file.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Upload, download or delete Salesforce Files with the registered user's permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, content_version_id or content_document_id (15- or 18-character ids), file_path or output_path (a non-empty string), the upload body (an object with PathOnClient and no VersionData of its own) or a query parameter does not match the vendor shape. sf.import_path_refused: the path must be absolute, have the required suffix where specified, and lie under a saved path address, the session folder or solet home, outside the installation tree. Input files must already exist. sf.export_path_refused: the path must be absolute, have the required suffix where specified, and lie under a saved path address, the session folder or solet home, outside the installation tree. Input files must already exist. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.bad_request (400, for example a file over the vendor's size limit), sf.session_expired or sf.auth_failed (401), sf.permission_denied (403), sf.not_found (404), sf.api_error otherwise.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the status and the vendor message before retrying. A permission error means the registered user cannot see or own the file or the record it is shared to; grant it in Salesforce. A checksum mismatch kept nothing; download again. Never repeat an upload automatically: each upload creates a new version.
